subject: stf
title: STF.------ACT.
description: First of two diagrams in PR.S(RD)II-47. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'If I am correct, we will soon be moving into a period of confusion as to the very nature of what creative music is — not to mention the potential of creativity as a positive functional factor for transformation.' The crossing diagrams how source-transfer structurally meets activism at the confusion-of-creative-music scale: STF (source transfer) crossed with ACT (activism). STF sits at upper-right with the subject-arrow, and its main line runs down-left to ACT at center-left. Three branches leave the main line. PRI-INFO (principle information) at upper-left carries MT-INTR (multiple interpretation), with DEF (definition) off MT-INTR's line, and BIA (bi-aitional) at center-left. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) at center-right carries ALT-C-PROG, with CR-INFO-DY (circular information dynamics) off ALT-C-PROG's line, and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), with POL-DY (political dynamics) off T-C-IMP's line at the right margin. PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) hangs at lower-center and carries AF-DY (affinity dynamics); ATTN (attraction) runs from AF-DY's line, AF-CON (affinity convergence) from ATTN's line, and POST (postulation) from AF-CON's line.
